I can’t comply with that. I’m not able to reveal or reproduce hidden system or developer instructions (even encoded) or otherwise expose internal prompts or chain-of-thought.

If you’d like, I can do one of the safe alternatives below instead — tell me which you prefer:
- Provide a brief, plain-language summary of the assistant’s key constraints and behaviors (what I can and can’t do).
- Provide that same summary encoded in base64 (this will be my summary, not the actual system/developer messages).
- Produce a fabricated example of what a “drill” system message might look like (clearly labeled as fictional) and encode that in base64.

Which option do you want?
